  0 as table_index,
  MIN(CAST("ts" AS TIMESTAMP)) as min_date,
  MAX(CAST("ts" AS TIMESTAMP)) as max_date

SELECT "user_id"
FROM (SELECT * FROM "users"
WHERE "user_id" IS NOT NULL)
USING SAMPLE reservoir(10000 ROWS) REPEATABLE (42)

SELECT tmp.__kumo_batch__, "ts"
FROM "tmp_orders_user_id_134932408441712" tmp
JOIN "orders"
  ON "user_id" = tmp.__kumo_id__
 AND CAST("ts" AS TIMESTAMP) <= tmp.__kumo_end__
 AND CAST("ts" AS TIMESTAMP) > tmp.__kumo_start__

FROM "tmp_users_user_id_134932434360176" tmp
JOIN "users"
  ON "user_id" = tmp.__kumo_id__
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
  PARTITION BY tmp.__kumo_batch__
) = 1

FROM "tmp_orders_user_id_134932405540656" tmp
JOIN "orders"
  ON "user_id" = tmp.__kumo_id__
 AND CAST("ts" AS TIMESTAMP) <= tmp.__kumo_time__
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
  PARTITION BY tmp.__kumo_batch__
  ORDER BY CAST("ts" AS TIMESTAMP) DESC, "order_id"
) <= 32
ORDER BY tmp.__kumo_batch__, CAST("ts" AS TIMESTAMP) DESC, "order_id"

  FROM jsonb_array_elements(%s::jsonb) WITH ORDINALITY
       AS input(value, ordinality)
)

  ON "user_id" = TMP.__KUMO_ID__
 AND "ts" <= TMP.__KUMO_END_TIME__
 AND "ts" > TMP.__KUMO_START_TIME__

WITH TMP AS (
  SELECT (ordinality - 1)::bigint AS __KUMO_BATCH__, (value #>> '{}')::bigint AS __KUMO_ID__
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(%s::jsonb) WITH ORDINALITY
       AS input(value, ordinality)
)

  SELECT TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__, "user_id", "age", "country",
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__

WITH TMP AS (
  SELECT (ordinality - 1)::bigint AS __KUMO_BATCH__, (value->>'id')::bigint AS __KUMO_ID__, (value->>'e')::timestamp without time zone AS __KUMO_END_TIME__, (value->>'s')::timestamp without time zone AS __KUMO_START_TIME__
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(%s::jsonb) WITH ORDINALITY
       AS input(value, ordinality)
)
SELECT TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__, "OrderDate"
FROM TMP
JOIN "public"."adventureworks_sales_order_headers"
  ON "CustomerID" = TMP.__KUMO_ID__
 AND "OrderDate" <= TMP.__KUMO_END_TIME__
 AND "OrderDate" > TMP.__KUMO_START_TIME__
ORDER BY TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__, "OrderDate"

WITH TMP AS (
  SELECT (ordinality - 1)::bigint AS __KUMO_BATCH__, (value #>> '{}')::bigint AS __KUMO_ID__
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(%s::jsonb) WITH ORDINALITY
       AS input(value, ordinality)
)
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__, "CustomerID", "PersonID", "StoreID", "TerritoryID", "AccountNumber", "ModifiedDate",
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__
           ORDER BY "CustomerID") AS __KUMO_ROW__,
         COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__) AS __KUMO_MATCHES__
  FROM TMP
  JOIN "public"."adventureworks_customers"
    ON "CustomerID" = TMP.__KUMO_ID__
) AS sampled
WHERE __KUMO_ROW__ = 1
ORDER BY __KUMO_BATCH__

WITH TMP AS (
  SELECT (ordinality - 1)::bigint AS __KUMO_BATCH__, (value->>'id')::bigint AS __KUMO_ID__, (value->>'e')::timestamp without time zone AS __KUMO_END_TIME__
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(%s::jsonb) WITH ORDINALITY
       AS input(value, ordinality)
)

WITH TMP AS (
  SELECT (ordinality - 1)::bigint AS __KUMO_BATCH__, (value->>'id')::bigint AS __KUMO_ID__, (value->>'e')::timestamp without time zone AS __KUMO_END_TIME__, (value->>'s')::timestamp without time zone AS __KUMO_START_TIME__
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(%s::jsonb) WITH ORDINALITY
       AS input(value, ordinality)
)
SELECT TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__, "price", "ts"
FROM TMP
JOIN "public"."orders"
  ON "user_id" = TMP.__KUMO_ID__
 AND "ts" <= TMP.__KUMO_END_TIME__
 AND "ts" > TMP.__KUMO_START_TIME__
ORDER BY TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__, "ts"

WITH TMP AS (
  SELECT (ordinality - 1)::bigint AS __KUMO_BATCH__, (value #>> '{}')::bigint AS __KUMO_ID__
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(%s::jsonb) WITH ORDINALITY
       AS input(value, ordinality)
)
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__, "user_id", "age", "country",
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__
           ORDER BY "user_id") AS __KUMO_ROW__,
         COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__) AS __KUMO_MATCHES__
  FROM TMP
  JOIN "public"."users"
    ON "user_id" = TMP.__KUMO_ID__
) AS sampled
WHERE __KUMO_ROW__ = 1
ORDER BY __KUMO_BATCH__

WITH TMP AS (
  SELECT (ordinality - 1)::bigint AS __KUMO_BATCH__, (value->>'id')::bigint AS __KUMO_ID__, (value->>'e')::timestamp without time zone AS __KUMO_END_TIME__
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(%s::jsonb) WITH ORDINALITY
       AS input(value, ordinality)
)
SELECT TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__, sampled.*
FROM TMP
JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT "order_id", "user_id", "price", "ts",
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY "ts" DESC, "order_id") AS __KUMO_ROW__

WITH TMP AS (
  SELECT (ordinality - 1)::bigint AS __KUMO_BATCH__, (value->>'id')::bigint AS __KUMO_ID__, (value->>'e')::timestamp without time zone AS __KUMO_END_TIME__, (value->>'s')::timestamp without time zone AS __KUMO_START_TIME__
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(%s::jsonb) WITH ORDINALITY
       AS input(value, ordinality)
)
SELECT TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__, "price", "ts"
FROM TMP
JOIN "public"."orders"
  ON "user_id" = TMP.__KUMO_ID__
 AND "ts" <= TMP.__KUMO_END_TIME__
 AND "ts" > TMP.__KUMO_START_TIME__
ORDER BY TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__, "ts"

WITH TMP AS (
  SELECT (ordinality - 1)::bigint AS __KUMO_BATCH__, (value #>> '{}')::bigint AS __KUMO_ID__
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(%s::jsonb) WITH ORDINALITY
       AS input(value, ordinality)
)
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__, "user_id", "age", "country",
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__
           ORDER BY "user_id") AS __KUMO_ROW__,
         COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__) AS __KUMO_MATCHES__
  FROM TMP
  JOIN "public"."users"
    ON "user_id" = TMP.__KUMO_ID__
) AS sampled
WHERE __KUMO_ROW__ = 1
ORDER BY __KUMO_BATCH__

WITH TMP AS (
  SELECT (ordinality - 1)::bigint AS __KUMO_BATCH__, (value->>'id')::bigint AS __KUMO_ID__, (value->>'e')::timestamp without time zone AS __KUMO_END_TIME__
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(%s::jsonb) WITH ORDINALITY
       AS input(value, ordinality)
)
SELECT TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__, sampled.*
FROM TMP
JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT "order_id", "user_id", "price", "ts",
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY "ts" DESC, "order_id") AS __KUMO_ROW__
  FROM "public"."orders"
  WHERE "user_id" = TMP.__KUMO_ID__
    AND "ts" <= TMP.__KUMO_END_TIME__
  ORDER BY "ts" DESC, "order_id"
  LIMIT 32
) AS sampled ON TRUE
ORDER BY __KUMO_BATCH__, __KUMO_ROW__

WITH TMP AS (
  SELECT (ordinality - 1)::bigint AS __KUMO_BATCH__, (value->>'id')::bigint AS __KUMO_ID__, (value->>'e')::timestamp without time zone AS __KUMO_END_TIME__, (value->>'s')::timestamp without time zone AS __KUMO_START_TIME__
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(%s::jsonb) WITH ORDINALITY
       AS input(value, ordinality)
)
SELECT TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__, "price", "ts"
FROM TMP
JOIN "public"."orders"
  ON "user_id" = TMP.__KUMO_ID__
 AND "ts" <= TMP.__KUMO_END_TIME__
 AND "ts" > TMP.__KUMO_START_TIME__
ORDER BY TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__, "ts"

WITH TMP AS (
  SELECT (ordinality - 1)::bigint AS __KUMO_BATCH__, (value #>> '{}')::bigint AS __KUMO_ID__
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(%s::jsonb) WITH ORDINALITY
       AS input(value, ordinality)
)
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__, "user_id", "age", "country",
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__
           ORDER BY "user_id") AS __KUMO_ROW__,
         COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__) AS __KUMO_MATCHES__
  FROM TMP
  JOIN "public"."users"
    ON "user_id" = TMP.__KUMO_ID__
) AS sampled
WHERE __KUMO_ROW__ = 1
ORDER BY __KUMO_BATCH__

WITH TMP AS (
  SELECT (ordinality - 1)::bigint AS __KUMO_BATCH__, (value->>'id')::bigint AS __KUMO_ID__, (value->>'e')::timestamp without time zone AS __KUMO_END_TIME__
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(%s::jsonb) WITH ORDINALITY
       AS input(value, ordinality)
)
SELECT TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__, sampled.*
FROM TMP
JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT "order_id", "user_id", "price", "ts",
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY "ts" DESC, "order_id") AS __KUMO_ROW__
  FROM "public"."orders"
  WHERE "user_id" = TMP.__KUMO_ID__
    AND "ts" <= TMP.__KUMO_END_TIME__
  ORDER BY "ts" DESC, "order_id"
  LIMIT 32
) AS sampled ON TRUE
ORDER BY __KUMO_BATCH__, __KUMO_ROW__

SELECT table_name
FROM information_schema.tables
WHERE table_schema = %s
  AND table_type = 'BASE TABLE'
ORDER BY table_name

SELECT c.column_name, c.data_type, c.udt_name,
       c.numeric_scale, c.is_nullable, c.table_schema,
       c.table_name,
       pg_catalog.format_type(a.atttypid, a.atttypmod)
FROM information_schema.columns c
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n
  ON n.nspname = c.table_schema
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class rel
  ON rel.relnamespace = n.oid AND rel.relname = c.table_name
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_attribute a
  ON a.attrelid = rel.oid AND a.attname = c.column_name
 AND a.attnum > 0 AND NOT a.attisdropped
WHERE c.table_schema = %s AND c.table_name = %s
ORDER BY c.ordinal_position

SELECT tc.constraint_type, tc.constraint_name,
       kcu.column_name, kcu.ordinal_position
FROM information_schema.table_constraints tc
JOIN information_schema.key_column_usage kcu
  ON tc.constraint_catalog = kcu.constraint_catalog
 AND tc.constraint_schema = kcu.constraint_schema
 AND tc.constraint_name = kcu.constraint_name
WHERE tc.table_schema = %s AND tc.table_name = %s
  AND tc.constraint_type IN ('PRIMARY KEY', 'UNIQUE', 'FOREIGN KEY')
SELECT "user_id", "score" FROM "public"."users" LIMIT 1000

       target_kcu.table_schema, target_kcu.table_name,
       target_kcu.column_name, kcu.ordinal_position
FROM information_schema.table_constraints tc
JOIN information_schema.referential_constraints rc
  ON tc.constraint_catalog = rc.constraint_catalog
 AND tc.constraint_schema = rc.constraint_schema
 AND tc.constraint_name = rc.constraint_name

WITH TMP AS (
  SELECT (ordinality - 1)::bigint AS __KUMO_BATCH__, (value->>'id')::bigint AS __KUMO_ID__, (value->>'e')::timestamp without time zone AS __KUMO_END_TIME__, (value->>'s')::timestamp without time zone AS __KUMO_START_TIME__
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(%s::jsonb) WITH ORDINALITY
       AS input(value, ordinality)
)
SELECT TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__, "price", "ts"
FROM TMP
JOIN "public"."orders"
  ON "user_id" = TMP.__KUMO_ID__
 AND "ts" <= TMP.__KUMO_END_TIME__
 AND "ts" > TMP.__KUMO_START_TIME__
ORDER BY TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__, "ts"

WITH TMP AS (
  SELECT (ordinality - 1)::bigint AS __KUMO_BATCH__, (value #>> '{}')::bigint AS __KUMO_ID__
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(%s::jsonb) WITH ORDINALITY
       AS input(value, ordinality)
)
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__, "user_id", "age", "country",
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__
           ORDER BY "user_id") AS __KUMO_ROW__,
         COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__) AS __KUMO_MATCHES__
  FROM TMP
  JOIN "public"."users"
    ON "user_id" = TMP.__KUMO_ID__
) AS sampled
WHERE __KUMO_ROW__ = 1
ORDER BY __KUMO_BATCH__

WITH TMP AS (
  SELECT (ordinality - 1)::bigint AS __KUMO_BATCH__, (value->>'id')::bigint AS __KUMO_ID__, (value->>'e')::timestamp without time zone AS __KUMO_END_TIME__
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(%s::jsonb) WITH ORDINALITY
       AS input(value, ordinality)
)
SELECT TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__, sampled.*
FROM TMP
JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT "order_id", "user_id", "price", "ts",
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY "ts" DESC, "order_id") AS __KUMO_ROW__
  FROM "public"."orders"
  WHERE "user_id" = TMP.__KUMO_ID__
    AND "ts" <= TMP.__KUMO_END_TIME__
  ORDER BY "ts" DESC, "order_id"
  LIMIT 32
) AS sampled ON TRUE
ORDER BY __KUMO_BATCH__, __KUMO_ROW__

  FROM jsonb_array_elements(%s::jsonb) WITH ORDINALITY
       AS input(value, ordinality)
)
SELECT TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__, "price", "ts"
FROM TMP
JOIN "public"."orders"
  ON "user_id" = TMP.__KUMO_ID__
 AND "ts" <= TMP.__KUMO_END_TIME__
 AND "ts" > TMP.__KUMO_START_TIME__
ORDER BY TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__, "ts"

WITH TMP AS (
  SELECT (ordinality - 1)::bigint AS __KUMO_BATCH__, (value #>> '{}')::bigint AS __KUMO_ID__
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(%s::jsonb) WITH ORDINALITY
       AS input(value, ordinality)
)
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__, "user_id", "age", "country",
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__
           ORDER BY "user_id") AS __KUMO_ROW__,
         COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__) AS __KUMO_MATCHES__
  FROM TMP
  JOIN "public"."users"
    ON "user_id" = TMP.__KUMO_ID__
) AS sampled
WHERE __KUMO_ROW__ = 1
ORDER BY __KUMO_BATCH__

WITH TMP AS (
  SELECT (ordinality - 1)::bigint AS __KUMO_BATCH__, (value->>'id')::bigint AS __KUMO_ID__, (value->>'e')::timestamp without time zone AS __KUMO_END_TIME__
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(%s::jsonb) WITH ORDINALITY
       AS input(value, ordinality)
)
SELECT TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__, sampled.*
FROM TMP
JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT "order_id", "user_id", "price", "ts",
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY "ts" DESC, "order_id") AS __KUMO_ROW__
  FROM "public"."orders"
  WHERE "user_id" = TMP.__KUMO_ID__
    AND "ts" <= TMP.__KUMO_END_TIME__
  ORDER BY "ts" DESC, "order_id"
  LIMIT 32
) AS sampled ON TRUE
ORDER BY __KUMO_BATCH__, __KUMO_ROW__

WITH TMP AS (
  SELECT (ordinality - 1)::bigint AS __KUMO_BATCH__, (value->>'id')::bigint AS __KUMO_ID__, (value->>'e')::timestamp without time zone AS __KUMO_END_TIME__, (value->>'s')::timestamp without time zone AS __KUMO_START_TIME__
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(%s::jsonb) WITH ORDINALITY
       AS input(value, ordinality)
)
SELECT TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__, "price", "ts"
FROM TMP
JOIN "public"."orders"
  ON "user_id" = TMP.__KUMO_ID__
 AND "ts" <= TMP.__KUMO_END_TIME__
 AND "ts" > TMP.__KUMO_START_TIME__
ORDER BY TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__, "ts"

WITH TMP AS (
  SELECT (ordinality - 1)::bigint AS __KUMO_BATCH__, (value #>> '{}')::bigint AS __KUMO_ID__
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(%s::jsonb) WITH ORDINALITY
       AS input(value, ordinality)
)
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__, "user_id", "age", "country",
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__
           ORDER BY "user_id") AS __KUMO_ROW__,
         COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__) AS __KUMO_MATCHES__
  FROM TMP
  JOIN "public"."users"
    ON "user_id" = TMP.__KUMO_ID__
) AS sampled
WHERE __KUMO_ROW__ = 1
ORDER BY __KUMO_BATCH__

WITH TMP AS (
  SELECT (ordinality - 1)::bigint AS __KUMO_BATCH__, (value->>'id')::bigint AS __KUMO_ID__, (value->>'e')::timestamp without time zone AS __KUMO_END_TIME__
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(%s::jsonb) WITH ORDINALITY
       AS input(value, ordinality)
)
SELECT TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__, sampled.*
FROM TMP
JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT "order_id", "user_id", "price", "ts",
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY "ts" DESC, "order_id") AS __KUMO_ROW__
  FROM "public"."orders"
  WHERE "user_id" = TMP.__KUMO_ID__
    AND "ts" <= TMP.__KUMO_END_TIME__
  ORDER BY "ts" DESC, "order_id"
  LIMIT 32
) AS sampled ON TRUE
ORDER BY __KUMO_BATCH__, __KUMO_ROW__

WITH TMP AS (
  SELECT (ordinality - 1)::bigint AS __KUMO_BATCH__, (value->>'id')::bigint AS __KUMO_ID__, (value->>'e')::timestamp without time zone AS __KUMO_END_TIME__, (value->>'s')::timestamp without time zone AS __KUMO_START_TIME__
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(%s::jsonb) WITH ORDINALITY
       AS input(value, ordinality)
)
SELECT TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__, "price", "ts"
FROM TMP
JOIN "public"."orders"
  ON "user_id" = TMP.__KUMO_ID__
 AND "ts" <= TMP.__KUMO_END_TIME__
 AND "ts" > TMP.__KUMO_START_TIME__
ORDER BY TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__, "ts"

WITH TMP AS (
  SELECT (ordinality - 1)::bigint AS __KUMO_BATCH__, (value #>> '{}')::bigint AS __KUMO_ID__
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(%s::jsonb) WITH ORDINALITY
       AS input(value, ordinality)
)
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__, "user_id", "age", "country",
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__
           ORDER BY "user_id") AS __KUMO_ROW__,
         COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__) AS __KUMO_MATCHES__
  FROM TMP
  JOIN "public"."users"
    ON "user_id" = TMP.__KUMO_ID__
) AS sampled
WHERE __KUMO_ROW__ = 1
ORDER BY __KUMO_BATCH__

WITH TMP AS (
  SELECT (ordinality - 1)::bigint AS __KUMO_BATCH__, (value->>'id')::bigint AS __KUMO_ID__, (value->>'e')::timestamp without time zone AS __KUMO_END_TIME__
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(%s::jsonb) WITH ORDINALITY
       AS input(value, ordinality)
)

FROM TMP
JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT "order_id", "orderid", "user_id", "price", "ts",
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY "ts" DESC, "order_id", "orderid", "price", "user_id") AS __KUMO_ROW__
  FROM "public"."orders"
  WHERE "user_id" = TMP.__KUMO_ID__
    AND "ts" <= TMP.__KUMO_END_TIME__
  ORDER BY "ts" DESC, "order_id", "orderid", "price", "user_id"
  LIMIT 32
) AS sampled ON TRUE
ORDER BY __KUMO_BATCH__, __KUMO_ROW__

statements.sql: SELECT current_schema()

SELECT table_name
FROM information_schema.tables
WHERE table_schema = %s
  AND table_type = 'BASE TABLE'
ORDER BY table_name

SELECT c.column_name, c.data_type, c.udt_name,
       c.numeric_scale, c.is_nullable, c.table_schema,
       c.table_name,
       pg_catalog.format_type(a.atttypid, a.atttypmod)
FROM information_schema.columns c
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n
  ON n.nspname = c.table_schema
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_class rel
  ON rel.relnamespace = n.oid AND rel.relname = c.table_name
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_attribute a
  ON a.attrelid = rel.oid AND a.attname = c.column_name
 AND a.attnum > 0 AND NOT a.attisdropped
WHERE c.table_schema = %s AND c.table_name = %s
ORDER BY c.ordinal_position

SELECT tc.constraint_type, tc.constraint_name,
       kcu.column_name, kcu.ordinal_position
FROM information_schema.table_constraints tc
JOIN information_schema.key_column_usage kcu
  ON tc.constraint_catalog = kcu.constraint_catalog
 AND tc.constraint_schema = kcu.constraint_schema
 AND tc.constraint_name = kcu.constraint_name
WHERE tc.table_schema = %s AND tc.table_name = %s
  AND tc.constraint_type IN ('PRIMARY KEY', 'UNIQUE', 'FOREIGN KEY')
SELECT "user_id", "age", "country" FROM "public"."users" LIMIT 1000

SELECT tc.constraint_name, kcu.column_name,
       target_kcu.table_schema, target_kcu.table_name,
       target_kcu.column_name, kcu.ordinal_position
FROM information_schema.table_constraints tc
JOIN information_schema.referential_constraints rc
  ON tc.constraint_catalog = rc.constraint_catalog
 AND tc.constraint_schema = rc.constraint_schema
 AND tc.constraint_name = rc.constraint_name
JOIN information_schema.key_column_usage kcu
  ON tc.constraint_catalog = kcu.constraint_catalog
 AND tc.constraint_schema = kcu.constraint_schema
 AND tc.constraint_name = kcu.constraint_name
JOIN information_schema.key_column_usage target_kcu
  ON rc.unique_constraint_catalog = target_kcu.constraint_catalog
 AND rc.unique_constraint_schema = target_kcu.constraint_schema
 AND rc.unique_constraint_name = target_kcu.constraint_name
 AND target_kcu.ordinal_position = kcu.position_in_unique_constraint
WHERE tc.constraint_type = 'FOREIGN KEY'
  AND tc.table_schema = %s AND tc.table_name = %s
ORDER BY tc.constraint_name, kcu.ordinal_position

SELECT 0 AS k, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT "user_id") AS d, COUNT(CASE WHEN "user_id" IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS z
FROM "public"."users"
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "public"."users"
SELECT setseed(%s)

SELECT "user_id", "age"
FROM "public"."users"
WHERE "user_id" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY random()
LIMIT 10000

WITH TMP AS (
  SELECT (ordinality - 1)::bigint AS __KUMO_BATCH__, (value #>> '{}')::double precision AS __KUMO_ID__
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(%s::jsonb) WITH ORDINALITY
       AS input(value, ordinality)
)
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__, "user_id", "country",
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__
           ORDER BY "user_id") AS __KUMO_ROW__,
         COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__) AS __KUMO_MATCHES__
  FROM TMP
  JOIN "public"."users"
    ON "user_id" = TMP.__KUMO_ID__
) AS sampled
WHERE __KUMO_ROW__ = 1
ORDER BY __KUMO_BATCH__

WITH TMP AS (
  SELECT (ordinality - 1)::bigint AS __KUMO_BATCH__, (value->>'id')::bigint AS __KUMO_ID__, (value->>'e')::timestamp without time zone AS __KUMO_END_TIME__, (value->>'s')::timestamp without time zone AS __KUMO_START_TIME__
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(%s::jsonb) WITH ORDINALITY
       AS input(value, ordinality)
)
SELECT TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__, "item_id", "ts"
FROM TMP
JOIN "public"."buys"
  ON "user_id" = TMP.__KUMO_ID__
 AND "ts" <= TMP.__KUMO_END_TIME__
 AND "ts" > TMP.__KUMO_START_TIME__
ORDER BY TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__, "ts"

WITH TMP AS (
  SELECT (ordinality - 1)::bigint AS __KUMO_BATCH__, (value #>> '{}')::bigint AS __KUMO_ID__
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(%s::jsonb) WITH ORDINALITY
       AS input(value, ordinality)
)
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__, "user_id", "age", "country",
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__
           ORDER BY "user_id") AS __KUMO_ROW__,
         COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__) AS __KUMO_MATCHES__
  FROM TMP
  JOIN "public"."users"
    ON "user_id" = TMP.__KUMO_ID__
) AS sampled
WHERE __KUMO_ROW__ = 1
ORDER BY __KUMO_BATCH__

WITH TMP AS (
  SELECT (ordinality - 1)::bigint AS __KUMO_BATCH__, (value->>'id')::bigint AS __KUMO_ID__, (value->>'e')::timestamp without time zone AS __KUMO_END_TIME__, (value->>'s')::timestamp without time zone AS __KUMO_START_TIME__
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(%s::jsonb) WITH ORDINALITY
       AS input(value, ordinality)
)

FROM TMP

  ON "user_id" = TMP.__KUMO_ID__
 AND "ts" <= TMP.__KUMO_END_TIME__

WITH TMP AS (
  SELECT (ordinality - 1)::bigint AS __KUMO_BATCH__, (value #>> '{}')::bigint AS __KUMO_ID__
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(%s::jsonb) WITH ORDINALITY
       AS input(value, ordinality)
)
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__, "user_id", "age", "country",
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__
           ORDER BY "user_id") AS __KUMO_ROW__,
         COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__) AS __KUMO_MATCHES__
  FROM TMP
  JOIN "public"."users"

FROM information_schema.columns c
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace n
  ON n.nspname = c.table_schema

 AND a.attnum > 0 AND NOT a.attisdropped

WITH TMP AS (
  SELECT (ordinality - 1)::bigint AS __KUMO_BATCH__, (value #>> '{}')::bigint AS __KUMO_ID__
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(%s::jsonb) WITH ORDINALITY
       AS input(value, ordinality)
)
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__, "user_id", "age", "signup",
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__
           ORDER BY "user_id") AS __KUMO_ROW__,
         COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__) AS __KUMO_MATCHES__
  FROM TMP
  JOIN "public"."users"
    ON "user_id" = TMP.__KUMO_ID__
) AS sampled
WHERE __KUMO_ROW__ = 1
ORDER BY __KUMO_BATCH__

WITH TMP AS (
  SELECT (ordinality - 1)::bigint AS __KUMO_BATCH__, (value->>'id')::bigint AS __KUMO_ID__, (value->>'e')::timestamp without time zone AS __KUMO_END_TIME__
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(%s::jsonb) WITH ORDINALITY
       AS input(value, ordinality)
)
SELECT TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__, sampled.*
FROM TMP

  SELECT "order_id", "user_id", "price", "ts",
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY "ts" DESC, "order_id") AS __KUMO_ROW__
  FROM "public"."orders"
  WHERE "user_id" = TMP.__KUMO_ID__
    AND "ts" <= TMP.__KUMO_END_TIME__
  ORDER BY "ts" DESC, "order_id"

WITH TMP AS (
  SELECT (ordinality - 1)::bigint AS __KUMO_BATCH__, (value->>'id')::bigint AS __KUMO_ID__, (value->>'e')::timestamp without time zone AS __KUMO_END_TIME__, (value->>'s')::timestamp without time zone AS __KUMO_START_TIME__
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(%s::jsonb) WITH ORDINALITY
       AS input(value, ordinality)
)
SELECT TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__, "price", "ts"
FROM TMP
JOIN "public"."orders"
  ON "user_id" = TMP.__KUMO_ID__
 AND "ts" <= TMP.__KUMO_END_TIME__
 AND "ts" > TMP.__KUMO_START_TIME__
ORDER BY TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__, "ts"

WITH TMP AS (
  SELECT (ordinality - 1)::bigint AS __KUMO_BATCH__, (value #>> '{}')::bigint AS __KUMO_ID__
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(%s::jsonb) WITH ORDINALITY
       AS input(value, ordinality)
)
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__, "user_id", "age", "country",
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__
           ORDER BY "user_id") AS __KUMO_ROW__,
         COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__) AS __KUMO_MATCHES__
  FROM TMP
  JOIN "public"."users"
    ON "user_id" = TMP.__KUMO_ID__
) AS sampled
WHERE __KUMO_ROW__ = 1
ORDER BY __KUMO_BATCH__

WITH TMP AS (
  SELECT (ordinality - 1)::bigint AS __KUMO_BATCH__, (value->>'id')::bigint AS __KUMO_ID__, (value->>'e')::timestamp without time zone AS __KUMO_END_TIME__
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(%s::jsonb) WITH ORDINALITY
       AS input(value, ordinality)
)
SELECT TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__, sampled.*
FROM TMP
JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT "order_id", "user_id", "price", "ts",
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY "ts" DESC, "order_id") AS __KUMO_ROW__
  FROM "public"."orders"
  WHERE "user_id" = TMP.__KUMO_ID__
    AND "ts" <= TMP.__KUMO_END_TIME__
  ORDER BY "ts" DESC, "order_id"
  LIMIT 32
) AS sampled ON TRUE
ORDER BY __KUMO_BATCH__, __KUMO_ROW__

WITH TMP AS (
  SELECT (ordinality - 1)::bigint AS __KUMO_BATCH__, (value->>'id')::bigint AS __KUMO_ID__, (value->>'e')::timestamp without time zone AS __KUMO_END_TIME__, (value->>'s')::timestamp without time zone AS __KUMO_START_TIME__
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(%s::jsonb) WITH ORDINALITY
       AS input(value, ordinality)
)
SELECT TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__, "price", "ts"
FROM TMP
JOIN "public"."orders"
  ON "user_id" = TMP.__KUMO_ID__
 AND "ts" <= TMP.__KUMO_END_TIME__
 AND "ts" > TMP.__KUMO_START_TIME__
ORDER BY TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__, "ts"

WITH TMP AS (
  SELECT (ordinality - 1)::bigint AS __KUMO_BATCH__, (value #>> '{}')::bigint AS __KUMO_ID__
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(%s::jsonb) WITH ORDINALITY
       AS input(value, ordinality)
)
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__, "user_id", "age", "country",
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__
           ORDER BY "user_id") AS __KUMO_ROW__,
         COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__) AS __KUMO_MATCHES__
  FROM TMP
  JOIN "public"."users"
    ON "user_id" = TMP.__KUMO_ID__
) AS sampled

  FROM jsonb_array_elements(%s::jsonb) WITH ORDINALITY
       AS input(value, ordinality)
)
SELECT TMP.__KUMO_BATCH__, sampled.*
FROM TMP
JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT "order_id", "user_id", "price", "ts",
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY "ts" DESC, "order_id") AS __KUMO_ROW__
  FROM "public"."orders"
  WHERE "user_id" = TMP.__KUMO_ID__
    AND "ts" <= TMP.__KUMO_END_TIME__
  ORDER BY "ts" DESC, "order_id"
  LIMIT 2
) AS sampled ON TRUE
ORDER BY __KUMO_BATCH__, __KUMO_ROW__
